description: A support landing section with a floating chat panel, quick-reply suggestions, and a launcher button.
overview: The page area shows an eyebrow, a heading, and a photo. A chat panel with `role="dialog"` floats over it: full-width near the bottom on small screens, and a fixed-width panel in the bottom corner from `sm:`. The panel has a header with a close `Button`, a `MessageScroller` of `Message` and `Bubble` items, outline `Button` quick replies, and a composer built from `Input` and a send `Button`. Closing the panel scales it down and reveals a round launcher `Button` that reopens it.
usage: Edit the `answers` record at the top of the file: its keys become the quick-reply buttons (through `quick`), and its values are the assistant's responses. Any other question gets a fallback message about connecting to a Specialist. Change the greeting in the initial `lines` state and the hero photo in the `image` constant. Open state, messages, the typing indicator, and the draft are held in `React.useState`; the `ask` function simulates a reply after 1200 ms, so replace it with your support backend. Quick replies disappear once they have been asked.
notes: The panel has `aria-label="suiss Support chat"` and is `inert` while closed; the launcher has `aria-expanded` and is `inert` while the panel is open. When the panel closes, a `React.useEffect` moves focus back to the launcher. Icon buttons are labeled (Close chat, Open chat, Add attachment, Send), the viewport is labeled Support conversation, and the typing bubble has `aria-label="Typing"`. The hero photo has descriptive `alt` text and loads from Unsplash; replace it with your own. Animations are disabled with `motion-reduce:`.
